title: Last of the Summer Wine: Big Day At Dream Acres
original_title: Last of the Summer Wine: Big Day At Dream Acres
overview: There's a big fête approaching at Dream Acres. Compo, Clegg and Seymour happen upon a wiley transient, who persuades them to help him rescue his childhood donkey from a field. Soon, the tramp's plan of fixing the fête 'donkey derby' is revealed.
